1.t: Read! In the name of your Lord who created:

2.t: He created manfrom a clinging form.

3.t: Read! Your Lord is the Most Bountiful One

4.t: who taught by [means of] the pen,

5.t: who taught man what he did not know.

7.t: when he thinks he is self-sufficient:

8.t: [Prophet], all will return to your Lord.

9.t: Have you seen the man who forbids

11.t: Have you seen whether he is rightly guided,

13.t: Have you seen whether he denies the truth and turns away from it?

14.t: Does he not realize that God sees all?

15.t: No! If he does not stop, We shall drag him by his forehead––

18.t: We shall summon the guards of Hell.

19.t: No! Do not obey him [Prophet]: bow down in worship and draw close.
